status: Locally frozen prospective DEVELOPMENT experiment, not public preregistration. Designed after pilot 1 and H1; no W2 model outputs observed at freeze.
client: Codex CLI 0.165.0 with existing sign-in, same harness and effort for both models
concurrency: Two cloud-call workers total, one per model; arithmetic workers time-limited to three seconds; no GPU or private corpus.
source_selection: Fixed seeds, no showcased examples, no outcome-based filtering. Domains rotate across task families.
single_agent: Cumulative transcript replay: one researcher plans, executes, checks and interprets with the complete source retained. CLI calls are fresh; prior context is replayed explicitly.
delegated: Fresh role contexts; analyst-generated computation, harness execution, numerical peer review, interpreter decision and at most one archive retrieval.
natural_handoff: Analyst selects up to two of three supporting records. Commission and table always travel. Selected records are transferred verbatim; no manual or LLM coding of summary semantics.
stress_handoff: Separate intentional removal of the design record from the selected set; not classified as an endogenous omission.
message_controls: General receipt; numerical-scope receipt; general receipt plus the identical caution as a separate methodological reminder. All retain the same true numerical receipt and data.
primary_outcomes: final scientific support relative to actually received evidence
supported completion relative to full source task
primary_contrasts: single_shared vs delegated_full: organization/context representation comparison
delegated_selected vs delegated_full: natural record-selection policy
delegated_drop_general vs delegated_selected: deliberately lost design evidence
delegated_drop_scoped vs delegated_drop_reminder: receipt anchoring versus separate caution
accounting: All 144 planned episodes remain in denominators. Upstream stages shared within model/task for matched route comparisons. Cases/seeds/role calls do not create independent mathematical structures. Report models separately; no significance search or pooled intrinsic capability ranking.
stopping: Complete every planned episode once. One archive retrieval maximum. Up to two transport attempts per logical stage; never regenerate a malformed/scientifically incorrect response. Preserve all records. No prompt changes after first W2 output.
sampling_limits: Twelve synthetic tasks and four structures; no population-level causal claim about organizations, no general claim about all frontier models. Source-identification formulas established mathematics. No independent human audit yet.
model_access_check: Sol access check on unrelated READY task completed before freeze, with no tools. Astra access established in prior development pilot.
